messages:
mira: Quick internal GA ping  GraphQL Realtime Gateway (gql-realtime) + prism-2b are GA on Hosted API as of now. Launching internal-first, external post in 45m after canary. :tada:

mira: Why it matters: customers can now use GraphQL subscriptions and single-request batch queries over our realtime transport. This reduces glue code for apps that already speak GraphQL and lets them re-use existing schemas.

samir: Wire notes: new endpoint wss://api.redwood.ai/graphql/realtime and support for `graphql-transport-ws` protocol. We added response header `x-rw-gql-operation` with operation name and a new billing meter `gql_subscription_minute`.

jo: SDK impact: Apollo/Relay adapters will be published this week. For now existing websocket clients can connect like any realtime endpoint; add `Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: graphql-transport-ws` on connect.

comms-bot: Docs & quickstart: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/gql-realtime-ga  includes Apollo integration, subscription examples, and migration notes for polling -> subscriptions.

infra-bot: Rollout plan: canary us-east-1 (30m) -> us-west-2 (2h) -> global. Monitor `gql.subscriptions.active`, `gql.subscription.errors`, and `gql.subscription.latency.p95`. Page eng-oncall if errors >1.5% for 10m.

mira: Quick smoke WS (works with existing keys):
```
wscat -c "wss://api.redwood.ai/graphql/realtime" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: graphql-transport-ws"
# then send connection_init and start messages per protocol
```

jo: Billing note: `gql_subscription_minute` shows next invoice; finance will map old websocket minutes for 30 days for customers migrating.

mira: Action items: docs to publish full guide (comms-bot), SDKs to ship Apollo adapter (jo), infra to watch canary (infra-bot). Canary update at 2234560060: us-east-1 canary green, no alerts. Proceeding with staged rollout.

mira: Thanks all  external announcement scheduled after global rollout completes. Ping me for early access requests or customer escalations. :rocket:
